title: RankTableGenerator
tagline: This project consists in a generator of Ranking Tables, these tables will consist on several accounts where we will see their ratings. A user can make as many tables as he wants and put as many accounts as he wants.
description: This proejct consists in a web application to generate Ranking(ELO) tables, these tables will save information of several accounts where they will have a token we will consider as ELO points. The user can define the elo algorithm as well as NFTS that will be used as achievements, maybe even money stream to the users who have the higher ranks
how_its_made: I used scaffold eth to make the web page, using hardhat and react app I made some tests with brownie and I was using super fluid contracts to check how the streams were built, I also used Thegraph techonologies to make tests but they are not connected to the main project. I was mostly checking how to solve NFTs solutions but they are not in the repository
